questions.question: Which version of Java standardized switch expressions with the arrow syntax (->)?
explanations: Java 5 added enums, not switch expressions.
Java 12 introduced them in preview, but Java 14 standardized them.
Correct. Java 14 standardized switch expressions with the arrow syntax.

questions.question: When is it MANDATORY to use default in a switch expression?
options: When not all possible values are covered
explanations: It is mandatory if you do not cover all cases — the expression must always return a value.
Not always; if you cover all values of an enum, default is optional.
Correct. If any value is left uncovered, the compiler requires default to guarantee a return value.
It depends on coverage, not on the type.

questions.question: Which keyword is used inside a switch expression block to return a value when there are multiple statements?
explanations: return exits the method, not the case.
break is not used in switch expressions with the arrow syntax.
Correct. yield returns the value of a block inside a switch expression.
value does not exist in Java.
